questions: State and prove De-Morgan's theorems using truth tables. Also, prove that NAND and NOR gates are universal gates.
Minimize a given Boolean function using K-map (typically 4-variable) and realize it using only NAND or NOR gates.
Explain the Race Around Condition in JK Flip-Flop. How is it solved using a Master-Slave JK Flip-Flop? Draw the logic diagram and timing diagram.
Design a Full Adder circuit using (a) basic logic gates or (b) a 3-to-8 line decoder and OR gates.
Explain the working of a Successive Approximation type A/D converter with a neat block diagram.
Differentiate between Synchronous and Asynchronous counters. Design a 3-bit/4-bit synchronous up/down counter.
Compare SRAM and DRAM. Also, list and explain the various types of ROM (PROM, EPROM, EEPROM).
Explain the working of a 4-bit Parallel Binary Adder and a Look-ahead Carry generator.
What is PLA? Implement a combinational circuit with multiple functions using a Programmable Logic Array.
Perform binary subtraction using 2's complement method and convert numbers between Decimal, Binary, Octal, and Hexadecimal.
